import.title: Import from a resume
import.description: Upload a PDF or Word (.docx) resume to fill in the form below. You review everything before anything is saved.

Jobs.title: Jobs
Jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Add one from a link or by pasting its description.

new.title: Add a job
new.description: Paste a link to the posting, or paste its text. We'll extract the requirements and you can then check how well your profile fits.
new.urlHint: LinkedIn, Indeed and Glassdoor links can't be read automatically; paste the text instead.
new.privacy: The posting text is sent to Claude (Anthropic) to extract the requirements, and to Voyage AI to make it searchable.

errors.invalidUrl: Enter a full http:// or https:// link.
errors.blockedSite: This site doesn't allow automated access. Copy the job description and paste it instead.
errors.blockedAddress: That address can't be reached from here. Use a public link or paste the text.
